info.name: CBA Platform API — Coming Soon (Planned Endpoints)
info.description:
# CBA Platform API — Planned / Not Yet Implemented

These endpoints are **planned** based on Apache Fineract / Mifos X API patterns and the CBA CLAUDE.md roadmap. They are NOT yet implemented in the backend.

## How to Use This Collection
- Use as a reference for the upcoming API surface
- Endpoints marked `[COMING SOON]` will return 404 until implemented
- Prioritise implementation based on your deployment needs

## Implementation Priority Guide
| Module | Priority | Depends On |
|--------|----------|------------|
| Group & Center | Medium | Customers |
| Savings Extended | High | Accounts |
| Loan Repayment Extended | High | Loans |
| Self Service | High | All modules |
| GL / Accounting | Medium | All modules |
| Reports | Low | All modules |
| CoB / Scheduling | Medium | Loans, Savings |
| User Management | High | Keycloak |
| Office Management | Medium | None |
| Notifications | Low | Events |

## Reference
These endpoints are modelled on:
- https://demo.mifos.io/api-docs/apiLive.htm#fullapi_matrix
- https://demo.mifos.io/api-docs/apiLive.htm#selfservice_overview
- https://github.com/apache/fineract

item.name: Close of Business (CoB) / Scheduler
item.description:
## Close of Business (CoB) Module (Planned)

Nightly batch processing for interest accrual, arrears classification, standing order execution, and fee charges.

### CoB Jobs
| Job | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| INTEREST_ACCRUAL | Accrue daily interest on savings and loans |
| ARREARS_CLASSIFICATION | Mark loans in arrears based on payment due dates |
| STANDING_ORDERS | Execute scheduled recurring transfers |
| LOAN_FEE_CHARGES | Apply scheduled loan fees |
| ACCOUNT_STATEMENT | Generate monthly account statements |

request.description:
⚠️ **NOT YET IMPLEMENTED** — This endpoint is planned based on Mifos/Fineract API patterns.

List all configured batch jobs and their last execution status.

⚠️ **NOT YET IMPLEMENTED** — This endpoint is planned based on Mifos/Fineract API patterns.

Manually trigger a batch job. Admin only.

⚠️ **NOT YET IMPLEMENTED** — This endpoint is planned based on Mifos/Fineract API patterns.
